I couldn't write `notes/pointer-lock.json`. I have no file-writing tool in this session, so nothing on disk has changed. I also worked only from the file contents you pasted, not from the files in `/home/dev/0c2a03/app`. Save this to `app/notes/pointer-lock.json`:

FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{ "lockedNoButton": false, "lockedButtonHeld": false, "rightDrag": true, "touchDrag": true }
```

The notes say `attachFreeControl` turns the camera on a drag with button 0, 1 or 2 (notes 40 and 66), so a right-button drag turns it without the lock, and the no-button case does nothing. The notes don't say whether the drag delta comes from `clientX` or `movementX`. I assumed `clientX`, which stays fixed under pointer lock, so I answered `false` for the locked cases. If the code uses `movementX`, `lockedButtonHeld` would be `true`. The touch answer is also inferred: touch pointers report button 0, but the notes don't cover touch for free controls. A quick test in the browser will settle the two uncertain fields.
